the synthesis of novel MnO2 ion sieve with high lithium ion exchange capacity and the adsorption mechanism of lithium ion on MnO2 nanosized ion sieve.
the preparation and characterization of MnO2 nanocrystallites with different crystal faces,which have been found to be effective in the adsorption of lithium ions.
the synthesis,structure and lithium ion adsorption properties of nanocrystallines MnO2 ion sieve.
